description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. Supersedes bnd-0014, which asserted https://a.example/... IRIs while stating no site.base, so the AGSC-05-01 item IRI could not be derived from the vector alone (Q55d). Same case: a retired item keeps its page and its IRI, leaves search.json, the chunk set, llms.txt and every composition, stays in the graph with asc:retiredAt, a selection naming it is AGSC-E802, and a Link to it is the warning AGSC-E411 on the linking item.
